summary: GLM-5.3-Flash starts on GB10 (DGX Spark) with the NVFP4 MTP draft head
compatibility: No change on RTX PRO 6000. On GB10, VLLM_GLM53_MTP_DRAFT_HEAD=nvfp4 no longer stops startup.
details: The quantized draft vocabulary head required compute capability exactly 12.0; it now accepts the SM120 family, which includes GB10 (12.1). FlashInfer builds its W4A16 kernels for 12.0f.
The draft-head tests pass on GB10.
